method: R3 source-fitted cuboids retain axes and anatomy. Overshooting compact fits use minimum relative half-extent correction plus center support within each immutable original component envelope. Missing coplanar source patches on cover, grip, butt, recesses and support are restored with bounded segmented rotated cuboids; no source component deletion or all-triangle regression. Explicit design geometry is deterministic.
